content: Pole va ningi dji Malete
Tunoghobulu, tumadjabe yiri ningi eni adjitumabe, djinengulu Malete.
Bise ningi abasamavosaange mbembu Ngereke bamatudile na musighe. Mvule djimamwénoghe na wumabe yotsi, kaboghu bamabanze mudji wuneni na bamatudile djetu botsu.
Pole anoboole dighuki di batsyenzu mu utume o mudji, pili djimapale na mbabisile na djimaghobe mu dikake dyandi.
Ave bise ningi bamalabile pili djivyunge mu dikake di Pole, bamatsingusene yi: «Dibaale dyédidi adji yikongu, mumbari bunzonzi bu Nzambi bughémusingisi udile monyu, ne nana atsighobululu mu mubu.»
Tumbe Pole amanyaghule nyoghe o ghari mudji, ne udile bwali.
Bamatasa yiri orande vo ufu, tumbe banokélise yitsingu. Bamalabe yiri aghédili dyambu, bamavinze posulu novose, kaboghu adji wumosi va ghari banyambi.
Beli na mbure eni vamabe kande dji yivunde yi ningi, dibaale dine dyandi Publyuse. Djandi amatudile burange na amatulatse bilumbu biryeru.
Tadji Publyuse amabe va tangi, amabe na dibaghu na amavanze malungu. Pole amawende ombu wandi, anosambile Nzambi, amamusakighe makake na djandi amabelughe.
Va djulu vane, batu basusu ba ningi abamabe nobele, bamarughe na bamabelughe.
Bamatughobise mu minongu myotsu. Temu djuwende mu watange djinotole, bamatuveghe byotsu abimabe biwelimine na mulingu.
Pole amatole o musyengi Rome
Miweli miryeru minovyoghe, tumanaangeme mu watange dji Alesanderi, bamanengilaange «Mavase
», djimavyose mvule va yisyeni yi ningi.
Tumatole o musyengi Sirakuse, avane tumatsane bilumbu biryeru.
Tunoghusughe vane, tumaduke mughule tena tumatole o musyengi Redjo. Ave kedi, punge adji bande dji mapepe, mbana tumatole mu bilumbu bibedji tena o musyengi Puzole otumasunduyile.
Mune musyengi eni, tumadale baane ba ngudji, bamatulende uvyose tsone nowu. Anane tumatolile o bulongu bu Rome.

Baane ba ngudji ba Rome banowulu bilumbi mu dyambu dyetu, bamayitubengusune va dibaghe dinengulu «Apyuse» na musyengi winengulu «Mandaghu Maryeru ma Beni». Pole anobalabe, amaghabusile Nzambi diboti na amawarusu.
Tunotole o Rome, bamasingise Pole ube na djandi mbure vike, na ghore adjimamukelisaange.
Pole esamunyi Musamu Wuboti o bulongu bu Rome

Bilumbu biryeru binovyoghe, Pole amanengile ombu wandi bivunde bi baSwife abavu o Rome. Banoghukeme, amabatsingule: «Bane batadji, ne nane nyisamavayile dyambu divyakene na mutsanu mukute etu vo na nzalusulu dji baghulu betu. Ne nane, nyimaghangu o Serusaleme, nowakusu ombu bise Rome.
Banonkwivule byuvu, basusu mbé baronde undunde, mumbari basamadile dyambu mu menu adyumfundisile vo dyumbokile.
Tumbe barumitsi ba baSwife bamabuse, kaboghu nyimanengile Kaghe Sesare. Nyisamabe na ditase dyufwengilili bise bulongu bwami.
Ladibandu, nyimarondile ubengunu nenu no duvosile. Va djulu vane, nyitungu na bapange beni babe, dibandu djandi awu mukute Yisrayele wivivi.»
Bamamuwawule rye: «Tusamadile mighande mi Sudé mu dyambu dyaghu, ne mwane tadji mosi asamarughesene ghune, mu ututsingule mambu vo mu uvosile dibi.
Tumbe, twirondi wuketutsingule ndebeni dyambu adi witasi, mumbari twidjabi yiri mbure tsyotsu, wudji batu bévosi dibi mu nde.»

Bamavangene na Pole, na yilumbu yi ndayi, bamarughe yinombu yineni nomurasune va mbure adji amatsanine. Ubande kedi tena tsisighe, Pole amabavindiyile mambu. Amabasamunine Bukaghe bu Nzambi, amarombe ubasungighe mu dyambu di Djesu, na akerangaange na dyufi dineni, mighaghe mi Moyise na mabuku ma Babiyitsi.
Bamosi bamabembu na mambu ame amavosaange, tumbe basusu bamabuse umavayile yitu.
Ave bamabandile uwende ughambu uwulusunu, Pole amabatsingule didi rye: «Yinyuni Yisyeme yimabe na ndunge, ave amavosilaange na baghulu benu mu munu mubiyitsi Yisayi!
Yimavosaange rye:

content.text: Ubuse nane, mbé boghabughe ombu wami, yiri nyubabeluse.”»

content: Pole amabwese rye: «Djabanu didi Nzambi amatinde musamu wu dughobutsu ombu abagha baSwife. Bomuwululu djowu!» [
Mu bighume byeni bi Pole, baSwife bamawende notsundaange va ghari owu.]
Pole amatsane mipume mibedji mu ndaghu adji amafutaange. Amadile botsu abamarondaange umulabe.
Amalonzaange Bukaghe bu Nzambi na mambu ameghéngili Fumu Djesu Kirisete, na musighe wughambu ukungusu.
